source.ndvi: NASA MODIS MOD13Q1.061, 250 m, 16-day composite, via NASA AppEEARS Point Sample (LP DAAC)
source.climate: NASA POWER Daily API (point), community AG

method: Single 250 m MOD13Q1 pixel at each province centre (AppEEARS point sample); images with pixel_reliability not in {0 Good, 1 Marginal} treated as missing and gap-filled with calendar_rule.fill_gaps; then the same rule-based peak detection, nearest saved k-means centroid (not refitted) and sensitivity grid as the 5 sample districts.
pointNote: Province centre from mekongBoundaries.js; ONE 250 m pixel (not a 2 km block, not a farm survey). Province-level calendar only.
